description: This file defines the Connection class for MySQL database interactions within Drupal, implementing connection handling, version detection, error codes, and transaction management.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Implements MySQL-specific database connection handling, including version detection, error handling, and transaction management within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Connection object, setting identifier quotes based on SQL mode.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Creates and configures a new PDO connection to MySQL, handling connection options and errors.

methods.name: queryRange
methods.description: Executes a query with LIMIT and OFFSET for range-based retrieval.

methods.name: queryTemporary
methods.description: Creates a temporary table with the specified query.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the server version, detecting MariaDB if applicable.

methods.name: isMariaDb
methods.description: Checks if the server is MariaDB.

methods.name: getMariaDbVersionMatch
methods.description: Extracts MariaDB version from server version string.

methods.name: getServerVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the server version string from the database.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new database and sets it as active.

methods.name: mapConditionOperator
methods.description: Returns NULL to use default condition operator mapping.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Returns a new Insert object for inserting data.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Returns a new Upsert object for upsert operations.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the schema object, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: driverTransactionManager
methods.description: Returns a new TransactionManager for handling transactions.
